title: OrderGPT: Generation Order as a Learnable Modeling Choice

summary.en: OrderGPT learns a task-level generation order from AO-GPT attention. A spectral teacher supervises OrderMLP priorities; training transitions to the learned order, which is frozen for autoregressive generation across language, human-pose, and tabular tasks.
summary.zh: OrderGPT 从 AO-GPT 注意力中学习任务级生成顺序，以谱教师监督 OrderMLP 的优先级预测，逐步转向学习到的顺序，并将其固定用于自回归生成，覆盖语言、人体姿态与表格任务。

cover.alt: Animated conceptual overview of OrderGPT: aggregated attention supports spectral supervision and OrderMLP priority learning, followed by autoregressive generation under one frozen task-level order. The displayed variable order is illustrative.

note.en: Internal comparisons from Table 1 use matched backbone capacity, preprocessing, and 400k-update budgets, with 1,024-token training contexts and no language-model EMA or prescribed L2R training mixture. The two AO-GPT rows evaluate the same checkpoint. OrderGPT freezes its learned task-level order for inference. These are reported perplexities, not generation perplexity or speed measurements; the paper also evaluates human-pose and tabular modeling.
note.zh: 取自表 1 的内部对照，统一骨干容量、预处理与 400k 更新预算，训练上下文为 1,024 token，不使用语言模型 EMA 或预设的 L2R 训练混合。两行 AO-GPT 使用同一检查点。OrderGPT 在推理时固定学习到的任务级顺序。这里是论文报告的困惑度，不是生成困惑度或速度指标；论文另有人体姿态与表格建模评测。
